summary: Cinematic Mediterranean editorial gouache with restrained brush grain, natural proportions, warm limestone, sea-glass reflected light and indigo evening contrast.

rendering.surface: controlled digital gouache with visible but subordinate brush grain
rendering.anatomy: natural adult proportions; no corrective deformation for mobile crops
rendering.edges: selective dry-brush edges with readable faces and hands
rendering.lighting: warm directional sun plus cool sea fill; indigo evening without neon rim light

identityAnchors: held-back speech in shoulders and hands

contactSheet.purpose: comparative exploratory canon; not runtime art
contactSheet.layout: 2x2 equal portrait studies with shared light and neutral limestone/sea-light setting
contactSheet.mobileSafeArea: negative lower-third for later dialogue overlay

prohibitedPatterns: neon rim light or excessive glow
glassmorphism or dashboard-like cards inside art
floating cut-out characters without a supporting ground plane
malformed anatomy, enlarged heads, disconnected hands or impossible joints
baked dialogue, UI, captions, logos, watermarks or signatures
wardrobe or props that contradict the narrative canon
all characters rendered with the same face, age or emotional expression
